name: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams integrates chat, video meetings, and file storage within Microsoft 365, providing virtual collaboration and communication for distributed teams

tools.name: Add chat member
tools.description: Tool to add a conversationMember to a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when adding a user to an existing chat conversation.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: Roles to assign to the member. Valid values are 'owner' or 'guest'. Leave empty to add as a standard member (not owner or guest).

inputs.name: chat_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the chat to which the member will be added.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's Graph ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) to add to the chat.

inputs.name: visible_history_start_date_time
inputs.about: Optional. Timestamp denoting how far back a conversation's history is shared with the conversation member. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Only settable for chat members.

tools.name: Add User to Group
tools.description: Add one directory user to a Microsoft 365 or security group.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: Directory user ID to add as a group member.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Target Microsoft 365 or security group ID.

tools.name: Add member to channel
tools.description: Tool to add a member to a Microsoft Teams channel. Use this action when you need to grant a user access to a specific channel within a team, or when you need to add an owner to manage the channel.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: Roles to assign to the member in the channel. Only 'owner' is supported by Microsoft Graph. Omit or leave empty to add as a standard member.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the team that contains the channel.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The Microsoft Graph user ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) of the member to add to the channel.

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the channel to add the member to.

tools.name: Add member to team
tools.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ADD_TEAM_MEMBER`) Add a user to a Microsoft Teams team, optionally assigning the owner role.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: Roles to assign to the member. Only 'owner' is supported. Omit or leave empty to add as a standard member.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique ID (GUID) of the Microsoft Team to which the member will be added.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's Graph ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) to add to the team.

tools.name: Add tab to channel
tools.description: Tool to add a new tab to a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to pin an app or website as a tab in a channel.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the team containing the channel where the tab will be added.

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the channel where the tab will be added. This is typically in the format '19:xxx@thread.tacv2' for standard channels.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The display name for the tab as it will appear to users in Microsoft Teams.

inputs.name: teams_app_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier or catalog reference of the Teams app to add as a tab. Common values: 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.web' for website tabs, 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.wiki' for Wiki, 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.planner' for Planner. The app must be installed in the team or available in the ap

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.about: Configuration settings for the tab.

tools.name: Add member to team
tools.description: Add a user to a Microsoft Teams team, optionally assigning an owner or guest role.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: Roles to assign to the member. Use ['owner'] for a team owner or ['guest'] for a guest. Omit or leave empty to add as a standard member. Microsoft Graph cannot add guest members with application permissions.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique ID (GUID) of the Microsoft Team to which the member will be added.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's Graph ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) to add to the team. Guest users must be referenced by object ID; Microsoft Graph does not support adding guests to a team by UPN/email.

tools.name: Add team members (bulk)
tools.description: Tool to add multiple members to a Microsoft Teams team in a single operation. Use when adding several users at once to improve efficiency.

inputs.name: values
inputs.about: Array of conversation members to add to the team. Each member must specify the user reference and optional roles.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the team to add members to.

tools.name: Add workbook table column
tools.description: Insert a column at a zero-based position in an Excel workbook table stored in a Microsoft Graph drive item.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Optional name for the new table column.

inputs.name: index
inputs.about: Zero-based insertion position. The existing column at this position shifts right; the index cannot append after the table's last column.

inputs.name: values
inputs.about: Optional two-dimensional array of unformatted values for the column.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Drive item ID of the Excel workbook.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Drive ID containing the Excel workbook.

inputs.name: table_id
inputs.about: Workbook table ID or name to receive the new column.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID that controls whether changes persist.

tools.name: Archive channel
tools.description: Tool to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to archive a specific channel within a team.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the team containing the channel to archive.

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the channel to archive. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:079fd66c7bf04c07a21430a9a32c2130@thread.tacv2').

inputs.name: should_set_spo_site_read_only_for_members
inputs.about: If true, sets the SharePoint site to read-only for team members when archiving the channel. Default is false.

tools.name: Archive team channel
tools.description: Tool to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team using the group ID. Use when you need to archive a specific channel within a team.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft 365 group associated with the team containing the channel to archive.

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the channel to archive. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:f95aa28eb1de46e994e1e8f8a40f2113@thread.tacv2').

inputs.name: should_set_spo_site_read_only_for_members
inputs.about: If true, sets the SharePoint site to read-only for team members when archiving the channel. Default is false.

tools.name: Archive Teams team
tools.description: Tool to archive a Microsoft Teams team. Use after confirming the team ID; returns 202 if accepted.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The Microsoft Teams team GUID to archive.

inputs.name: should_set_spo_site_read_only_for_members
inputs.about: If true, sets the SharePoint site to read-only for team members when archiving.

inputs.about: The number of provider chats to return per page (1-50). Microsoft Graph enforces a maximum of 50 per request. An unfiltered first page for user_id='me' can contain one additional synthetic self-chat. This action returns ONE page per call plus a `next_page_token`; pass that token back as `page_token`

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Caps how many provider chats this single call returns (bounds the page size). An unfiltered first page for user_id='me' can contain one additional synthetic self-chat beyond this limit. If more chats match than `limit`, the response includes a `next_page_token` — pass it back as `page_token` to fetc

inputs.name: filter
inputs.about: OData filter query string (do not include '$filter='). Supports filtering by chat properties like 'topic', 'chatType' (e.g., "chatType eq 'group'", "topic eq 'Project X'"), and 'installedApps/any(...)' for app-based filtering. The synthetic self-chat is included only when this is empty because its f

inputs.name: select
inputs.about: A list of specific Microsoft Graph chat resource properties to retrieve (e.g., 'id', 'topic'). If omitted or empty, a default set of properties is returned. inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The ID or user principal name (UPN) of the user whose chats are to be retrieved. Use 'me' to specify the currently authenticated user. An unfiltered first-page request for 'me' includes the user's self-chat (personal notes); use SEND_MESSAGE_TO_SELF to add a note or LIST_MESSAGES_TO_SELF to read it

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: Opaque continuation token for the next page. Omit for the first page; then pass back the `next_page_token` from the previous response, unmodified, until it is absent. tools.name: Clear Automatic Location
tools.description: Tool to clear the automatic location from a user's presence in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove automatically-set location information from presence status.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose automatic location will be cleared. Note: This endpoint does not support 'me' as an alias; you must provide the actual user GUID.

tools.name: Clear User Preferred Presence
tools.description: Tool to clear a user's preferred presence setting in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove the user's manually set presence status and allow the system to automatically determine their presence based on activity. Supports both delegated (user) and application (S2S) authentication.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's unique identifier or principal name. Use 'me' to clear the preferred presence of the authenticated user (delegated auth), or provide a specific user ID or email for application auth.

tools.name: Clear My Presence (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Clears an application's presence session for the authenticated user or a specified user in Microsoft Teams.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's unique identifier or principal name. Use 'me' to clear presence for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.about: The ID of the application's presence session to clear. Should be the application's client ID (appid). This parameter is required by the API.

tools.name: Clear Presence
tools.description: Clears presence information for a specified user's application presence session in Microsoft Teams.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose presence session to clear. Must be an explicit user ID (not 'me'). Note: You can only clear presence for the authenticated user - attempting to clear presence for other users will result in a 401 Unauthorized error. Use the user's object ID from Azure A

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: The ID of the application's presence session to clear. This must exactly match the application ID (client ID) used for authentication. The API will return a 400 error if the sessionId doesn't match. This parameter is required.

tools.name: Clear Presence Automatic Location (Deprecated)
tools.description: Deprecated. Clear the automatically detected presence location for the authenticated user or a specified user.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's unique identifier or principal name. Use 'me' to clear the presence location of the authenticated user (delegated auth). For application-only (S2S) authentication, provide the user's GUID or email address.

tools.name: Clear Presence Location
tools.description: Clear the presence location for the authenticated user or a specified user.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user's unique identifier or principal name. Use 'me' to clear the presence location of the authenticated user.

tools.name: Clear Workbook Range
tools.description: Clear values, formatting, or both from a range in a drive-hosted Excel workbook without deleting cells or shifting neighboring data.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: Range to clear in Excel A1 notation.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Drive item ID of the Excel workbook to modify.

inputs.name: apply_to
inputs.about: Part of the range to clear: All clears contents and formatting, Formats clears formatting only, and Contents clears values only. Microsoft Graph defaults to All when omitted.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Microsoft Graph drive ID containing the Excel workbook.

inputs.name: worksheet
inputs.about: Worksheet ID or name containing the range to clear.

inputs.name: workbook_session_id
inputs.about: Optional workbook session ID returned by Microsoft Graph.

tools.name: Clone Team
tools.description: Tool to clone a Microsoft Teams team using the team ID. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing team including its structure, channels, and tabs. This is an asynchronous operation; poll the returned location URL to monitor progress.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team to clone.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Visibility type for the cloned team.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An optional description for the cloned team. If not provided, it takes the value of displayName.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: The display name for the cloned team. This property is required when a team is cloned.

inputs.name: mailNickname
inputs.about: The mail alias for the cloned team. This property must be specified when a team is cloned. Must be unique in the organization.

inputs.name: partsToClone
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of parts to clone. Valid values: 'apps', 'tabs', 'settings', 'channels', 'members'. Defaults to a full clone (all five parts). Pass a narrower list to exclude parts; omitting 'members' clones a members-less team.

inputs.name: classification
inputs.about: Optional label describing the data or business sensitivity of the cloned team. Must match a preconfigured value in the tenant's directory.

tools.name: Create Call Operation
tools.description: Tool to create a new operation for a communications call. Use when you need to initiate a new operation on an active call.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Initial status of the operation. Possible values: notStarted, running, completed, failed.

inputs.name: call_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the call to create an operation for.

inputs.name: odata_type
inputs.about: The OData type of the operation entity. Must be '#microsoft.graph.commsOperation'.

inputs.name: client_context
inputs.about: Optional client context string for tracking the operation.

tools.name: Create a channel
tools.description: Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to create a new channel for team collaboration.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The display name for the new channel. Maximum length is 50 characters. Cannot contain the following characters: ~ # % & * { } + / \ : < > ? | ' " , or control characters. Cannot start with an underscore (_) or period (.)

inputs.name: members
inputs.about: JSON string containing array of conversationMember objects to add as owners/members when creating private or shared channels. Each member object should include '@odata.type' (e.g., '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember'), 'user@odata.bind' (user URL), and 'roles' array (e.g., ['owner']). Requi

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The GUID of the existing Microsoft Teams team where the new channel will be created.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An optional, user-friendly description of the channel's purpose. Maximum length is 1024 characters.

inputs.name: membership_type
inputs.about: Membership type determining channel accessibility: 'standard' is accessible to all team members, 'private' is only accessible to a specific subset of team members, and 'shared' can be shared with people outside the team or organization (requires appropriate policies).

inputs.name: created_date_time
inputs.about: The timestamp for when the channel was created. Only used when creating a channel in migration mode by including '@microsoft.graph.channelCreationMode': 'migration' in the request. Format: ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g., '2020-03-14T11:22:17.067Z').

inputs.name: shared_with_teams
inputs.about: JSON string containing array of team objects to share the channel with when creating a shared channel. Each object should contain an 'id' field with the team ID. Use this to share the channel with the host team or other teams.

inputs.name: is_favorite_by_default
inputs.about: Indicates whether the channel should be marked as recommended for all members of the team to show in their channel list. Can only be set during creation. Defaults to false if not specified.

tools.name: Create Content Sharing Session
tools.description: Tool to create a content sharing session in a Microsoft Teams call. Use when you need to initiate content sharing during an active call.

inputs.name: call_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the call in which to create the content sharing session.

tools.name: Create drive folder
tools.description: Create a child folder under a Microsoft drive item.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the folder to create.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the drive in which to create the folder.

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the drive item that will contain the new folder.

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: How Microsoft Graph handles an existing item with the same name: fail, replace, or rename. Omit to use the provider default.

tools.name: Create Drive Upload Session
tools.description: Create a resumable upload session for a new file below a drive folder.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Destination drive ID.

inputs.name: if_match
inputs.about: ETag precondition that requires the destination item to match.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Name of the new file, including its extension.

inputs.name: defer_commit
inputs.about: Require an explicit commit after all file ranges have been uploaded.

inputs.name: if_none_match
inputs.about: ETag precondition that requires the destination item not to match.

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: Destination folder driveItem ID.

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: Behavior when an item with the same name exists: fail, replace, or rename.

tools.name: Create group calendar event
tools.description: Create an event in a Microsoft 365 group calendar.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: Event end date, time, and time zone.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Optional text or HTML event body.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Event start date, time, and time zone.

inputs.name: show_as
inputs.about: Availability status shown during the event.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Event subject line.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Microsoft 365 group ID whose calendar receives the event.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: Optional event location.

inputs.name: attendees
inputs.about: People or resources invited to the event, up to 500 attendees.

inputs.name: importance
inputs.about: Event importance.

inputs.name: is_all_day
inputs.about: Whether this is an all-day event. Start and end must then be midnight in the same time zone.

inputs.name: sensitivity
inputs.about: Event sensitivity classification.

inputs.name: transaction_id
inputs.about: Client-generated identifier used by Microsoft Graph to avoid duplicate event creation on retries.

tools.name: Create channel in group team
tools.description: Tool to create a new channel in a group's associated team. Use when you have a group ID and need to create a channel in its team.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the group. This is the group ID, not the team ID. The group must have an associated team.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional textual description of the channel's purpose.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The display name for the new channel. Maximum length is 50 characters. This is the only required field.

inputs.name: membership_type
inputs.about: Channel membership type options.

inputs.name: is_favorite_by_default
inputs.about: Indicates whether the channel should be marked as recommended for all members of the team to show in their channel list. Can only be set during creation.

tools.name: Create online meeting
tools.description: Creates a standalone Microsoft Teams online meeting that is not linked to a calendar event. When an external ID is supplied, it creates or retrieves the meeting and accepts a narrower set of meeting options.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: The subject or title for the online meeting.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The user ID (object ID) on whose behalf to create the meeting. Required when using application permissions (S2S). If not specified, uses the /me endpoint (delegated permissions).

inputs.name: chat_info
inputs.about: Chat information to associate with an online meeting.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: A custom external identifier for the online meeting. Maps to Microsoft Graph externalId.

inputs.name: participants
inputs.about: An optional list of participants to invite to the meeting. Each participant is defined by their user ID and role.

inputs.name: end_date_time
inputs.about: The end date and time of the meeting, specified in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-15T11:00:00Z'). Must be after start_date_time.

inputs.name: allow_recording
inputs.about: Indicates whether recording is enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: start_date_time
inputs.about: The start date and time of the meeting, specified in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-15T10:00:00Z').

inputs.name: allow_live_share
inputs.about: Indicates whether Live Share is enabled for the meeting. Possible values: enabled, disabled.

inputs.name: allow_whiteboard
inputs.about: Indicates whether whiteboard is enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: chat_restrictions
inputs.about: Chat restrictions that Microsoft Graph accepts when creating an online meeting.

inputs.name: allow_meeting_chat
inputs.about: Specifies the mode of meeting chat. Possible values: enabled (default), disabled, limited (only during the meeting call).

inputs.name: allowed_presenters
inputs.about: Specifies who can be a presenter in a meeting. Possible values: everyone (default), organization, roleIsPresenter, organizer.

inputs.name: allow_transcription
inputs.about: Indicates whether transcription is enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: meeting_template_id
inputs.about: The ID of the meeting template. Using a custom meeting template to create a meeting is a Teams Premium feature.

inputs.name: allow_breakout_rooms
inputs.about: Indicates whether breakout rooms are enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: is_passcode_required
inputs.about: An optional boolean indicating whether a passcode should be required to join this meeting. If not specified, the organization's default policy applies.

inputs.name: record_automatically
inputs.about: Indicates whether to record the meeting automatically.

inputs.name: watermark_protection
inputs.about: Watermark protection settings that Microsoft Graph accepts when creating an online meeting.

inputs.name: lobby_bypass_settings
inputs.about: Specifies which participants can bypass the meeting lobby.

inputs.name: is_entry_exit_announced
inputs.about: Indicates whether to announce when callers join or leave.

inputs.name: allow_teamwork_reactions
inputs.about: Indicates whether Teams reactions are enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: allow_power_point_sharing
inputs.about: Indicates whether PowerPoint live is enabled for the meeting.

inputs.name: allow_attendee_to_enable_mic
inputs.about: Indicates whether attendees can unmute themselves.

inputs.name: allow_attendee_to_enable_camera
inputs.about: Indicates whether attendees can turn on their camera.

inputs.name: is_end_to_end_encryption_enabled
inputs.about: Indicates whether end-to-end encryption is enabled for the meeting. Note: This property must be used with Teams policies to determine the final behavior.

inputs.name: allow_participants_to_change_name
inputs.about: Specifies whether participants are allowed to rename themselves in an instance of the meeting.

inputs.name: share_meeting_chat_history_default
inputs.about: Specifies whether meeting chat history is shared with participants. Possible values: all, none.

inputs.name: allow_copying_and_sharing_meeting_content
inputs.about: Indicates whether participants can copy and share meeting content.

tools.name: Create user offer shift request
tools.description: Create an offer shift request in a team's schedule when a team member wants to offer their shift to another team member.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: Optional user identifier. Not used in the API request as the endpoint operates at the team level. Accepts 'me' or a GUID/UUID format.

inputs.name: odata_type
inputs.about: The OData type of the resource. Must be '#microsoft.graph.offerShiftRequest'.

inputs.name: sender_message
inputs.about: Optional message from the sender to the recipient explaining the shift offer.

inputs.name: sender_shift_id
inputs.about: The shift ID that is being offered. Format typically starts with 'SHFT_' followed by a GUID.

inputs.name: recipient_user_id
inputs.about: The user ID of the recipient to whom the shift is being offered. Must be a valid GUID/UUID.

inputs.name: recipient_action_message
inputs.about: Message from the recipient when responding to the offer. This is typically set when the recipient accepts or declines.

inputs.name: recipient_action_date_time
inputs.about: Date and time when the recipient responded to the offer, in ISO 8601 format. This is typically set by the system.

tools.name: Create open shifts
tools.description: Tool to create a new open shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to publish available shifts that team members can claim.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team (GUID format).

inputs.name: draft_open_shift
inputs.about: Represents the draft version of an open shift that has not been shared with the team.

inputs.name: shared_open_shift
inputs.about: The shared version of the open shift that is visible to team members. This contains the shift details including start/end times, theme, and open slot count.

inputs.name: scheduling_group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the scheduling group this open shift belongs to. Use format 'TAG_{guid}' for scheduling group IDs.

inputs.name: is_staged_for_deletion
inputs.about: Indicates whether the open shift is staged for deletion. Set to true to mark for deletion.

tools.name: Create open shift change request
tools.description: Tool to create a new open shift change request in a team schedule. Use when a team member wants to claim an available open shift.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Optional message from the user explaining why they want to claim this open shift.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team (GUID format).

inputs.name: openShiftId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the open shift that the user is requesting to claim. This ID references an existing open shift in the team's schedule.

inputs.name: senderUserId
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user who is requesting to claim the open shift.

tools.name: Create or get online meeting
tools.description: Tool to create a new Microsoft Teams online meeting or retrieve an existing one based on externalId. Use when you need an idempotent meeting creation operation that returns an existing meeting if the externalId matches.

inputs.name: userId

inputs.name: chatInfo

inputs.name: participants

inputs.name: startDateTime

inputs.name: swapShiftsRequestsEnabled

inputs.name: isActivitiesIncludedWhenCopyingShiftsEnabled

tools.name: Create Planner bucket

inputs.name: teamId

inputs.name: dayNoteDate

inputs.name: draftDayNote

inputs.name: sharedDayNote
inputs.about: Represents the content and format of a day note.

tools.name: Create scheduling group

This action uses 'team_id' parameter naming which aligns with the Microsoft Graph API endpoint (/teams/{id}/schedule/schedulingGroups).

inputs.name: code

inputs.name: team_id

inputs.name: display_name

tools.name: Create team schedule shift

inputs.name: userId

inputs.name: team_id

inputs.name: draftShift

inputs.name: sharedShift

inputs.name: schedulingGroupId

inputs.name: isStagedForDeletion
inputs.about: Indicates whether the shift is staged for deletion. Set to true to mark for deletion.

inputs.name: latest_supported_tls_version

tools.name: Create Team
tools.description: Create a new Microsoft Teams team with an optional template, channels, and members. Creation is asynchronous; the response provides an operation location for tracking progress.

inputs.name: members

inputs.name: channels
inputs.about: Collection of channels to create in the team. Note: The 'General' channel is created automatically.

inputs.name: description

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: Display name of the team as it will appear in Microsoft Teams. Note: The API allows duplicate team names, but using unique names is recommended for clarity.

inputs.name: funSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure use of Giphy, memes, and stickers in the team.

inputs.name: guestSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure whether guests can create, update, or delete channels in the team.

inputs.name: installedApps
inputs.about: Collection of apps to install in the team.

inputs.name: classification
inputs.about: Optional label describing the data or business sensitivity of the team. Must match a preconfigured value in the tenant's directory.

inputs.name: memberSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure whether members can perform certain actions in the team.

inputs.name: specialization
inputs.about: Indicates whether the team is intended for a particular use case. Each specialization has access to unique behaviors and experiences.

inputs.name: firstChannelName
inputs.about: Name of the first channel created; defaults to 'General' if omitted.

inputs.name: messagingSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure messaging and mentions in the team.

inputs.name: templateOdataBind
inputs.about: URL reference to the team template. Common templates: 'standard' (default), 'educationClass', 'educationStaff', 'educationProfessionalLearningCommunity'. Format: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/teamsTemplates('template-id')

inputs.name: guestSettings

inputs.name: memberSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure whether members can perform certain actions in the team.

inputs.name: messagingSettings
inputs.about: Settings to configure messaging and mentions in the team.

tools.name: Create time off

inputs.name: sharedTimeOff

inputs.name: isStagedForDeletion
inputs.about: Indicates whether the timeOff is marked for deletion. This process is finalized when the schedule is shared. Defaults to false.

tools.name: Create time off reason
tools.description: Tool to create a new time off reason in a team's schedule. Use when you need to define a new category for time off requests with a custom name and icon.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: Optional external identifier code for the time off reason. Must be unique within the team and alphanumeric, maximum 100 characters. Useful for integration with external systems.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: iconType
inputs.about: Icon to display for this time off reason in the schedule. Choose an icon that visually represents the reason type.

inputs.name: isActive
inputs.about: Whether this time off reason is active and available for use. Set to true to make it available immediately, false to create it as inactive.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: Name of the time off reason as it will appear in the schedule (e.g., 'Vacation', 'Sick Leave', 'Personal Day').

tools.name: Create time off request
tools.description: Tool to create a new time off request in a team's schedule. Use when a team member needs to request time off for vacation, sick leave, or other absences.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: odata_type
inputs.about: The OData type of the resource. Must be '#microsoft.graph.timeOffRequest'.

inputs.name: endDateTime
inputs.about: End date and time of the time off request in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-03-16T00:00:00Z'). This represents when the requested time off ends.

inputs.name: senderUserId

inputs.name: startDateTime
inputs.about: Start date and time of the time off request in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z'). This represents when the requested time off begins.

inputs.name: externalId

inputs.name: endDateTime

inputs.about: Indicates whether this meeting is a Teams live event. Deprecated.

inputs.name: startDateTime

inputs.name: meetingTemplateId

tools.name: Update scheduling group
tools.description: Tool to replace/update a scheduling group in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing scheduling group such as display name, active status, code, or member list.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: Code or identifier for the scheduling group. This can be used for external system integration or quick reference. Must contain only alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers, no special characters or spaces).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of user IDs to include as members of this scheduling group. Each ID should be a valid GUID/UUID. This replaces the existing list of members.

inputs.name: is_active
inputs.about: Indicates whether the scheduling group is active and available for scheduling. Set to true to enable, false to disable.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: Display name of the scheduling group. This is the name that will appear when managing schedules and shifts.

inputs.name: scheduling_group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the scheduling group to update. This can be a GUID or a tag-based ID (e.g., 'TAG_dc93d488-40de-443e-ac7d-ce86f22bef80').

tools.name: Renew Graph subscription
tools.description: Renew a Microsoft Graph subscription or replace its notification URL.

inputs.name: subscription_id
inputs.about: Microsoft Graph subscription ID to update.

inputs.name: notification_url
inputs.about: Replacement public HTTPS webhook URL for change notifications.

inputs.name: expiration_date_time
inputs.about: New UTC ISO 8601 expiration date and time for the subscription.

tools.name: Update Teams channel tab
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of a tab in a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to modify tab display name, configuration, or web URL.

inputs.name: tab_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the tab to update.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team containing the channel.

inputs.name: web_url
inputs.about: The deep link URL of the tab instance.

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the channel containing the tab.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The updated display name for the tab. This is what users will see in the channel.

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.about: Configuration settings for the tab.

tools.name: Update Team
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of a team. Use when you need to modify team settings such as member, messaging, or fun settings.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the team to update.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: The visibility of the team. Can be 'private' or 'public'.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An optional description for the team. Maximum length: 1024 characters.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: The name of the team.

inputs.name: funSettings
inputs.about: Settings that control fun features in the team.

inputs.name: classSettings
inputs.about: Settings specific to teams of type Class (education teams).

inputs.name: guestSettings
inputs.about: Settings that control what guests can do in the team.

inputs.name: classification
inputs.about: An optional label that describes the data or business sensitivity of the team.

inputs.name: memberSettings
inputs.about: Settings that control what members can do in the team.

inputs.name: specialization
inputs.about: Indicates whether the team is intended for a particular use case (education, etc.).

inputs.name: messagingSettings
inputs.about: Settings that control messaging capabilities in the team.

tools.name: Update team member
tools.description: Tool to update a team member's roles or properties in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to change a member's role (e.g., promote to owner or demote to member).

inputs.name: roles
inputs.about: The roles to assign to the member. Common values: 'owner', 'member', 'guest'. Pass an empty array to demote an owner to a regular member.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams team.

inputs.name: odata_type
inputs.about: The OData type identifier. Must be '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember' for Azure AD users.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: Optional display name for the member.

inputs.name: conversation_member_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the conversation member to update.

inputs.name: visible_history_start_date_time
inputs.about: Optional timestamp denoting how far back a conversation's history is shared with the member. ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: Update team schedule shift
tools.description: Tool to update an existing shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to modify shift details like times, assigned user, or notes.

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team (GUID format).

inputs.name: userId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the user assigned to this shift (GUID format).

inputs.name: shiftId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the shift to update (e.g., 'SHFT_67bbbd0f-ad83-46a1-a94f-fe9d9f29fb84').

inputs.name: draftShift
inputs.about: Represents the draft version of a shift that has not been shared with the team.

inputs.name: sharedShift
inputs.about: Represents the shared version of a shift that is visible to team members.

inputs.name: schedulingGroupId
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the scheduling group this shift belongs to. Set to null to remove from a scheduling group.

inputs.name: isStagedForDeletion
inputs.about: Indicates whether the shift is staged for deletion. Set to true to mark for deletion.

tools.name: Update time off
tools.description: Tool to replace an existing timeOff entry in a team's schedule. Use when you need to update time off details including dates, reason, or status.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: ID of the user assigned to this timeOff entry. Must be a valid user GUID (e.g., '43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f'). Required.

inputs.name: timeoff_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the timeOff entry to replace. This is the ID of the timeOff resource in the team's schedule (e.g., 'SHFT_d3b1de89-60b8-4e61-81b7-c55ab222c1ab').

inputs.name: draft_time_off
inputs.about: Represents a version of the timeOff entry (shared or draft).

inputs.name: shared_time_off
inputs.about: Represents a version of the timeOff entry (shared or draft).

inputs.name: is_staged_for_deletion
inputs.about: Indicates whether the timeOff is marked for deletion. This process is finalized when the schedule is shared. Optional.

tools.name: Update time off reason
tools.description: Tool to update a time off reason in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify the display name, icon, active status, or code of an existing time off reason.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: An alphanumeric code to represent an external identifier for this time off reason. Must be unique within the team. Maximum 100 characters.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707').

inputs.name: icon_type
inputs.about: Supported icon types for time off reasons.

inputs.name: is_active
inputs.about: Whether the time off reason is active and can be used when creating or updating time off entries. Set to false to deactivate without deleting.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The name of the time off reason. This is what will be displayed in the schedule.

inputs.name: time_off_reason_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the time off reason to update. This is the ID of the timeOffReason resource in the team's schedule.

tools.name: Upload drive file
tools.description: Upload a file up to 250 MB as a child of a Microsoft drive item. If a file with the same name already exists, this operation replaces its contents.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: File whose raw bytes will be uploaded with the operation's required text/plain Content-Type, regardless of the file's own media type.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Microsoft drive that will contain the file.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.about: Name to give the uploaded file, including its extension.

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the drive item under which to upload the file.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (email, name) of the connected Microsoft Teams account.
